name: Skin of Sweet Rum
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Skin of Sweet Rum is headed for Lakeshire, where war has thinned the tavern's stores.

sections.title: A Rare Comfort for Lakeshire
sections.body: Lakeshire's tavern is running short of drink as the Blackrock orc invasion closes the roads into the Redridge Mountains. Barkeep Daniels needs drink for the town guards and refugees. So he sends travelers to gather regional specialties, including a waterskin of sweet rum from the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

faq.q: Where can I find a Skin of Sweet Rum?
faq.answer: You can buy a Skin of Sweet Rum from the innkeeper or barkeep at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest.
Barkeep Daniels keeps the tavern in Lakeshire. He wants a skin of Sweet Rum and other regional brews to refill his shelves during Dry Times.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire running out of liquor?
aliases: why are they out of booze
faq.answer: The Blackrock orc invasion has cut the trade routes into Redridge. Merchant wagons cannot travel safely, and Lakeshire's liquor stocks are nearly empty.

faq.q: What other spirits are needed alongside the rum?
faq.answer: Barkeep Daniels also needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Westfall, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind City, and a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can see how the Blackrock orc invasion strains the small settlements defending Stormwind's eastern borders.
